concept: ECS Service Auto Scaling: target tracking on ALBRequestCountPerTarget
tests: How to scale the number of ECS tasks on Fargate by requests per target.
expected: ECS service auto scaling (Application Auto Scaling) with target tracking on the ALBRequestCountPerTarget metric. Triggers: "number of tasks", "request count per target", "Fargate".
why_not: An EC2 ASG doesn't apply to Fargate (no instances); scheduled scaling — time-based, not load-based; manually changing desired count isn't automation.
